import json, random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import para, topo, algo
rng = random.Random(9)
K = 256
ms = []
for i in range(1, K):
    ms.append([i, rng.randrange(i), -5, 5])
while len(ms) < 4096:
    a = rng.randrange(K); b = rng.randrange(K)
    if a != b: ms.append([a, b, -20, 20])
prof = {"groups": K, "jitter_ps": [rng.randint(0,10) for _ in range(K)], "measurements": ms}
t0=time.time(); cal = para.build_calib(prof); t1=time.time()
sys.stderr.write('calib %.2fs\n' % (t1-t0))
N=512; T=1; S=512; O=3; Q=1; P=512; L=1024
links=[]
for l in range(L):
    j=l//256; m=l%256
    links.append({"ends":[[2*m,j,rng.randrange(K)],[2*m+1,j,rng.randrange(K)]],
                  "delay_ns":[rng.randint(1,8),rng.randint(1,8)],
                  "defer_rounds":[rng.randint(0,8),rng.randint(0,8)]})
slices=[list(range(L))]
anchors=[[0,0,P]]
fb={"n":N,"interval_ns":T,"slice_ns":S,"offset_ns":O,
    "drift_ppb":[rng.randint(0,1000) for _ in range(N)],"heat":[],
    "anchors":anchors,"links":links,"slices":slices,"blackouts":[],
    "guards_ns":[0,1,5,20,60,120,200,255],"reconfig_ns":0}
t0=time.time(); fab=topo.Fabric(fb,cal); t1=time.time()
sys.stderr.write('fabric %.2fs edges=%d V=%d\n' % (t1-t0, fab.E, fab.V))
import resource
for g in [0,1,5,255]:
    t0=time.time(); best,pv,pk=algo.run_dijkstra(fab,g); peak,warm=algo.summarise(fab,best); t1=time.time()
    nfin=sum(1 for b in best if b is not None)
    sys.stderr.write('dijkstra g=%d %.2fs peak=%s warm=%s finite=%d\n' % (g,t1-t0,peak,warm,nfin))
sys.stderr.write('maxrss %.1f MiB\n' % (resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss/1024))
PYEOF
timeout 600 python3 perf1.py
